description: CONTAINER ORCHESTRATION — the sub-world of cloud_infrastructure: the Kubernetes object model, giving the concept-graph descent a third rung below cloud.

microtheory.name: container_orchestration
microtheory.definition: The Kubernetes model for running containers: pods scheduled onto cluster nodes, services and ingress routing traffic, replica sets and autoscalers keeping the declared state, namespaces and Helm charts packaging it.

concepts.name: pod
concepts.definition: The smallest deployable unit — one or more co-located containers.

concepts.name: node_cluster
concepts.definition: The set of worker machines a container orchestrator schedules onto.

concepts.name: service_mesh
concepts.definition: An infrastructure layer handling service-to-service communication.

concepts.name: ingress
concepts.definition: The rules routing external traffic into cluster services.

concepts.name: replica_set
concepts.definition: The controller keeping a specified number of pod replicas running.

concepts.name: scheduler
concepts.definition: The component assigning pods to nodes by resource and constraint.

concepts.name: namespace
concepts.definition: A virtual partition isolating groups of resources within a cluster.

concepts.name: helm_chart
concepts.definition: A packaged, templated definition of a Kubernetes application.
